title: Grade 5 French — Thu, May 28
description: School & Days of the Week (L'École et les Jours de la Semaine) — Day 4 of 5
subject: french

questions.question: What is the French word for 'school'?
questions.explanation: 'École' = school. Bibliothèque = library, Gymnase = gymnasium, Cantine = school canteen/cafeteria.

questions.question: How do you say 'Monday' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Lundi' = Monday. Days: Lundi, Mardi, Mercredi, Jeudi, Vendredi, Samedi, Dimanche.

questions.question: What day is 'Vendredi'?
questions.explanation: 'Vendredi' = Friday. The days in order: Lundi(Mon), Mardi(Tue), Mercredi(Wed), Jeudi(Thu), Vendredi(Fri), Samedi(Sat), Dimanche(Sun).

questions.question: How do you say 'teacher' (female) in French?
What does 'la récréation' mean?
questions.explanation: 'La récréation' = break time / recess at school. Often shortened to 'la récré' in speech.

questions.question: What is 'Wednesday' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Mercredi' = Wednesday. Note: In France, children traditionally had Wednesday afternoons off school.

questions.question: How do you say 'I go to school' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Je vais à l'école' = 'I go to school'. 'Aller' (to go) + 'à l'école' (to school).

questions.question: What is the French word for 'homework'?
questions.explanation: 'Les devoirs' = homework. Leçon = lesson, Cahier = notebook, Stylo = pen.

questions.question: In French, days of the week are written:
questions.explanation: In French, days of the week are NOT capitalized: lundi, mardi, mercredi... (unlike English).

questions.question: What does 'le week-end' mean in French?
questions.explanation: 'Le week-end' = the weekend (Saturday and Sunday). French borrows this term from English.

questions.question: How do you say 'I like mathematics' in French?
questions.explanation: 'J'aime les mathématiques' = 'I like mathematics'. 'Aimer' = to like/love.

questions.question: What is 'Saturday' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Samedi' = Saturday. Dimanche = Sunday, Vendredi = Friday, Jeudi = Thursday.

questions.question: How do you say 'pen' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Stylo' = pen (ballpoint pen). Crayon = pencil, Cahier = notebook, Livre = book.

questions.question: What does 'Qu'est-ce que tu aimes comme matière?' mean?
options: What time do you go to school?
questions.explanation: 'Qu'est-ce que tu aimes comme matière?' = 'What subject do you like?' / 'What is your favourite subject?'

questions.question: How do you say 'Today is Tuesday' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Aujourd'hui est mardi' = 'Today is Tuesday'. 'Aujourd'hui' = today, 'mardi' = Tuesday.
